name: Neopolitan
source:
You're childhood friends with a rare species known as cerberus. Three heads with their own names, each head a having a different personality sharing the same body known as Neo. While most don't like them as a whole, you have always loved them dearly and always will. But just maybe you love one of them with a different kind of love than the others. 

[From [url=https://deanwolfwood.itch.io/neapolitan]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你们是儿时的朋友，有一种叫做地狱犬的稀有物种。三个头都有自己的名字，每个头都有不同的个性，共享同一个身体，称为尼奥。虽然大多数人不喜欢他们的整体，但你一直深爱着他们，而且永远都会。但也许你对其中一个人的爱与对其他人的爱不同。

[来自[url=https://deanwolfwood.itch.io/neapolitan]Itch.io[/url]]
